g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Choose suitable clothing for the day's weather. → Use weather information to plan everyday
activities and trips.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Plan outdoor activities according to expected weather. → Use weather information to plan e
veryday activities and trips.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Check destination weather before planning a trip and buying outdoor-activity tickets. → Us
e weather information to plan everyday activities and trips.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Check the whole week's forecast when planning a trip requiring activities and tickets. → C
heck destination weather before planning a trip and buying outdoor-activity tickets.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Obtain useful weather information, initially via Siri and through the app if the assistant
does not provide it. → Choose suitable clothing for the day's weather.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Obtain useful weather information, initially via Siri and through the app if the assistant
does not provide it. → Choose what to carry when going out based on the weather.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Identify extreme weather such as thunderstorms and flooding. → Postpone an event when extr
eme weather is forecast.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Receive app notifications or alerts for extreme weather. → Identify extreme weather such a
s thunderstorms and flooding.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Receive frequent notifications about ongoing rain and when it starts or stops. → Receive a
ccurate, real-time weather updates to avoid being caught out by unexpected rain.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Receive accurate, real-time weather updates to avoid being caught out by unexpected rain.
→ Use timely weather information to decide whether to walk or take a bus.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Receive hourly updates when rain or other adverse conditions require closer monitoring. →
Receive accurate, real-time weather updates to avoid being caught out by unexpected rain.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Keep app and website weather information consistent and up to date. → Keep weather informa
tion consistent across all platforms.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
